title: Cryptographic Failures
short_description: Weak cryptographic algorithms, predictable keys, and password storage failures.
learning_objectives: Identify obsolete cryptographic algorithms (MD5/SHA1) and predictable secrets
Understand how unsalted hashes and weak keys succumb to rainbow tables and brute force
Implement modern adaptive password hashing (Argon2id/bcrypt) and authenticated encryption (AES-GCM)
